name: Transport Tycoon
what: Connect towns with trains, trucks, ships and planes, and grow a transport empire.

fanProjects.name: OpenTTD
fanProjects.what: A free remake that started from the 1995 game. It now has its own free graphics, sounds and music, so you need nothing else.
howToPlay: Download it from openttd.org, or get it free on Steam.
Start a new game and build your first bus line between two towns.

lovedFeatures: Build roads and rails on a map
Vehicles that carry people and goods
Money that goes up and down
Towns that grow when you connect them
